verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll/PEO platform that holds sensitive employee data, so letting customers choose a storage region or data residency is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and Xero integration, and nothing in it mentions storage region, residency choice or data location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
